fields.FIR_Description: During the afternoon of 2025-10-05, around 14:10, a message about KYC expiry led the complainant to a website where account credentials were entered, and Rs. 12,000 was transferred out, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-10-05. Pavithra Bai submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000006. Abirami Sri (9000000096) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. Transaction details refer to the receiving account SYN-ACC-100032. Madhan Palanisamy (9000000295), described as a business acquaintance, was also mentioned in the complaint. The complainant alleged that Mathan Velan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000147. Items referenced in the complaint: social media screenshots and a call detail reference.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Social media screenshot; Call detail reference
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim reported receiving a suspicious link that imitated a bank notification.
fields.Keywords: phishing, suspicious link, residential colony, call detail, screenshot, receiving account, witness, associate
